acc_conf_definition: Acc_conf = sum of confidence on correct valid rows / N; failed and incorrect contribute 0. mean_top_choice_confidence is distinct.

arms.acc_conf_definition: Acc_conf = sum_i 1[correct and no error and a valid predicted label] * confidence_i / N, N = every scored row including failures. Null, error, and incorrect rows contribute 0. Raw confidence is never rewritten. Missing or invalid confidence on a correct row is a hard error, not a filled-in zero. Every non-null confidence must be finite and in [0, 1]. This is not mean top-choice confidence and not acc_hard times a confidence mean.

provenance.timing_boundary: Loaded-model sequential single-email wall: immediately before request to resident ORIGINAL-sklearn CPU worker through original From/Subject/Body preprocessing, frozen TF-IDF transform, per-email NPZ serialization/hash/IPC, NPZ hash/load/CSR, H2D, native one-row predict+predict_proba, confidence/label D2H and decoding, final device synchronization. Startup/import/model/vectorizer/data loading and pre-call synchronization excluded; scoring/log writes after timer. NOT batch-wall/300; local IPC rather than B/C HTTP.
provenance.cold_warm_policy: One loaded fixed-model process,900 sequential actual single-email calls in frozen order as3 full300 passes. Zero inference warmups, no discarded calls. First-email lazy initialization retained. Later calls naturally warm; existing disk compilation cache allowed, not cache-cold.
